steps.text: In a large mug, melt 1 tablespoon of softened butter in the microwave for about 30 seconds
Roll the butter around in the mug to coat it
Cut or tear 1 slices of bread into bite-size pieces
In the mug, whisk one egg with a fork until well blended
Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon over the egg
Add 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract to the mug
add bread pieces to the egg mixture in the mug, pressing the bread down into the egg
Microwave on high for 90 seconds until the egg is cooked through
Put the mug's contents on a plate
cut the contents on plate, and serve
